texts.NIV84: One day Jesus was praying in a certain place. When he finished, one of his disciples said to him, "Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples."
texts.KJV: And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.
texts.NKJV: Now it came to pass, as He was praying in a certain place, when He ceased, that one of His disciples said to Him, “Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.”
texts.DRB: AND it came to pass, that as he was in a certain place praying, when he ceased, one of his disciples said to him: Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples.

texts.NIV84: He said to them, "When you pray, say: "'Father, hallowed be your name, your kingdom come.
texts.KJV: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done, as in heaven, so in earth.
texts.NKJV:
So He said to them, “When you pray, say:
Our Father in heaven,
Hallowed be Your name.
Your kingdom come.
Your will be done
On earth as it is in heaven.
texts.DRB: And he said to them: When you pray, say: Father, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come.

texts.NIV84: Give us each day our daily bread.
texts.KJV: Give us day by day our daily bread.
texts.NKJV: Give us day by day our daily bread.
texts.DRB: Give us this day our daily bread.

texts.NIV84: Forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation. '"
texts.KJV: And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil.
texts.NKJV:
And forgive us our sins,
For we also forgive everyone who is indebted to us.
And do not lead us into temptation,
But deliver us from the evil one.”
texts.DRB: And forgive us our sins, for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation.

texts.NIV84: Then he said to them, "Suppose one of you has a friend, and he goes to him at midnight and says, 'Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
texts.KJV: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves;
texts.NKJV: And He said to them, “Which of you shall have a friend, and go to him at midnight and say to him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves;
texts.DRB: And he said to them: Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go to him at midnight, and shall say to him: Friend, lend me three loaves,

texts.NIV84: because a friend of mine on a journey has come to me, and I have nothing to set before him.'
texts.KJV: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me, and I have nothing to set before him?
texts.NKJV: for a friend of mine has come to me on his journey, and I have nothing to set before him’;
texts.DRB: Because a friend of mine is come off his journey to me, and I have not what to set before him.

texts.NIV84: "Then the one inside answers, 'Don't bother me. The door is already locked, and my children are with me in bed. I can't get up and give you anything.'
texts.KJV: And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.
texts.NKJV: and he will answer from within and say, ‘Do not trouble me; the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give to you’?
texts.DRB: And he from within should answer, and say: Trouble me not, the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee.

texts.NIV84: I tell you, though he will not get up and give him the bread because he is his friend, yet because of the man's boldness he will get up and give him as much as he needs.
texts.KJV: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.
texts.NKJV: I say to you, though he will not rise and give to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence he will rise and give him as many as he needs.
texts.DRB: Yet if he shall continue knocking, I say to you, although he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend; yet, because of his importunity, he will rise, and give him as many as he needeth.

texts.NIV84: "So I say to you: Ask and it will be given to you; seek and you will find; knock and the door will be opened to you.
texts.KJV: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
texts.NKJV: “So I say to you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you.
texts.DRB: And I say to you, Ask, and it shall be given you: seek, and you shall find: knock, and it shall be opened to you.

texts.NIV84: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
texts.KJV: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.
texts.NKJV: For everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks it will be opened.
texts.DRB: For every one that asketh, receiveth; and he that seeketh, findeth; and to him that knocketh, it shall be opened.

texts.NIV84: "Which of you fathers, if your son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
texts.KJV: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?
texts.NKJV: If a son asks for bread from any father among you, will he give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, will he give him a serpent instead of a fish?
texts.DRB: And which of you, if he ask his father bread, will he give him a stone? or a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent?

texts.NIV84: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
texts.KJV: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
texts.NKJV: Or if he asks for an egg, will he offer him a scorpion?
texts.DRB: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he reach him a scorpion?

texts.NIV84: If you then, though you are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!"
texts.KJV: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?
texts.NKJV: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!”
texts.DRB: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father from heaven give the good Spirit to them that ask him?

blocks.title: Pray to the Father in Secret

texts.NIV84: "And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites, for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the street corners to be seen by men. I tell you the truth, they have received their reward in full.
texts.KJV: And when thou prayest, thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are: for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen of men. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.
texts.NKJV: “And when you pray, you shall not be like the hypocrites. For they love to pray standing in the synagogues and on the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Assuredly, I say to you, they have their reward.
texts.DRB: And when ye pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, that love to stand and pray in the synagogues and corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men: Amen I say to you, they have received their reward.

texts.NIV84: But when you pray, go into your room, close the door and pray to your Father, who is unseen. Then your Father, who sees what is done in secret, will reward you.
texts.KJV: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
texts.NKJV: But you, when you pray, go into your room, and when you have shut your door, pray to your Father who is in the secret place; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.
texts.DRB: But thou when thou shalt pray, enter into thy chamber, and having shut the door, pray to thy Father in secret: and thy Father who seeth in secret will repay thee.

texts.NIV84: And when you pray, do not keep on babbling like pagans, for they think they will be heard because of their many words.
texts.KJV: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
texts.NKJV: And when you pray, do not use vain repetitions as the heathen do. For they think that they will be heard for their many words.
texts.DRB: And when you are praying, speak not much, as the heathens. For they think that in their much speaking they may be heard.

texts.NIV84: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
texts.KJV: Be not ye therefore like unto them: for your Father knoweth what things ye have need of, before ye ask him.
texts.NKJV: “Therefore do not be like them. For your Father knows the things you have need of before you ask Him.
texts.DRB: Be not you therefore like to them, for your Father knoweth what is needful for you, before you ask him.

texts.NIV84: "This, then, is how you should pray: "'Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name,
texts.KJV: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
texts.NKJV:
In this manner, therefore, pray:
Our Father in heaven,
Hallowed be Your name.
texts.DRB: Thus therefore shall you pray: Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.

texts.NIV84: your kingdom come, your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.
texts.KJV: Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
texts.NKJV:
Your kingdom come.
Your will be done
On earth as it is in heaven.
texts.DRB: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

texts.NIV84: Give us today our daily bread.
texts.KJV: Give us this day our daily bread.
texts.NKJV: Give us this day our daily bread.
texts.DRB: Give us this day our supersubstantial bread.

texts.NIV84: Forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
texts.KJV: And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.
texts.NKJV:
And forgive us our debts,
As we forgive our debtors.
texts.DRB: And forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

texts.NIV84: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. '
texts.KJV: And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.
texts.NKJV:
And do not lead us into temptation,
But deliver us from the evil one.
For Yours is the kingdom and the power and the glory forever. Amen.
texts.DRB: And lead us not into temptation. But deliver us from evil. Amen.

texts.NIV84: For if you forgive men when they sin against you, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
texts.KJV: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you:
texts.NKJV: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
texts.DRB: For if you will forgive men their offences, your heavenly Father will forgive you also your offences.

texts.NIV84: But if you do not forgive men their sins, your Father will not forgive your sins.
texts.KJV: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
texts.NKJV: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
texts.DRB: But if you will not forgive men, neither will your Father forgive you your offences.

texts.NIV84: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
texts.KJV: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
texts.NKJV: Therefore I say to you, whatever things you ask when you pray, believe that you receive them, and you will have them.
texts.DRB: Therefore I say unto you, all things, whatsoever you ask when ye pray, believe that you shall receive; and they shall come unto you.

texts.NIV84: And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive him, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your sins."
texts.KJV: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.
texts.NKJV: “And whenever you stand praying, if you have anything against anyone, forgive him, that your Father in heaven may also forgive you your trespasses.
texts.DRB: And when you shall stand to pray, forgive, if you have aught against any man; that your Father also, who is in heaven, may forgive you your sins.

texts.NIV84: See Footnote
texts.KJV: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
texts.NKJV: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your trespasses.”
texts.DRB: But if you will not forgive, neither will your Father that is in heaven, forgive you your sins.
